actions.title: FUNDAE
actions.description: Training actions to submit to the foundation. Each action can be linked to a catalog course and exported as XML for manual upload to the official system.
actions.archiveConfirm: Archive action "{codigo}"? The row is preserved but no longer appears as active.
actions.emptyDescription: Start by creating your first FUNDAE action. Once created, you can generate the XML to submit to the foundation.
actions.participantsErrorTitle: We could not load the count
actions.formDescription: Data required by FUNDAE to submit the action. The code must be unique within the tenant.
actions.notesLabel: Internal notes (not included in the XML)

actionDetail.blocksDescription: Breakdown of the action into blocks. The hours add up to {total} out of a maximum of {max} ({estado}).
actionDetail.blocksEmpty: There are no blocks yet. Create the first one below.
actionDetail.participantsDescription: Each participant can have a signed PDF evidence file. The submission ZIP bundles the XML plus all the evidence files.
actionDetail.participantsEmpty: There are no active enrollments in the linked course.

companies.title: Subsidized companies
companies.description: Companies that fund training with FUNDAE credit. Each subsidized group is linked to one of them (costs and official communications inherit the tax details).
companies.deleteConfirm:
Delete company "{razonSocial}" ({nif})?

Soft delete: the row is preserved so closed groups keep their traceability. If it has active groups, the API will reject it.
companies.searchLabel: Search by tax ID or company name
companies.emptyDescription: Start by creating the subsidized company that will fund the first training group.
companies.editDescription: The tax ID cannot be changed: if the company changes its tax ID, a new entry must be created for historical traceability.
companies.createDescription: Minimal tax details. Tax ID validation accepts DNI, NIE and CIF with the Spanish checksum.

companyDetail.rlptDeleteConfirm:
Delete the {tipo} dated {fecha}?

The blob stays in the Evidence Vault for traceability. The row is marked as deleted.
companyDetail.rlptDescription: Documents required by Royal Decree 694/2017: the minimum notice between the initial notification and the start of the subsidized group is 15 calendar days. If the workers' legal representatives formalize a disagreement, register the statement to authorize moving forward with traceability.
companyDetail.statusOk: The company meets the deadlines to start subsidized groups.
companyDetail.statusMissingInitial: The initial notification to the RLPT is still missing.
companyDetail.statusWaiting: The 15 calendar days since the initial notification have not elapsed yet.
companyDetail.noticesEmpty: There are no registered notifications. Upload the initial notification to get started.
companyDetail.uploadDescription: Accepts PDF or image (PNG/JPG/WebP) up to 10 MB. The blob is persisted with a SHA-256 hash.
companyDetail.fileRequired: Attach a PDF or an image of the document.

groups.title: Subsidized groups
groups.description: A grouping of participants of a training action linked to a FUNDAE company. The consumed credit is debited from the company's credit on closing.
groups.transitionConfirm: Are you sure you want to {verb} this group?
groups.emptyDescription: Create the first subsidized group by linking a training action to a FUNDAE company.
groups.formDescription: The group is created in Draft status. Start the training to activate it (requires the 15-day RLPT notice and enough available credit).
groups.bulkEnrollConfirm: Enroll every enrollee of the catalog course?
groups.removeParticipantConfirm: Remove enrollment? It will remain in the history.

dashboard.title: Tenant panel
dashboard.description: How your organization is doing: classroom activity and business numbers.
dashboard.rangeNote: Enrollments and certificates respect the range; active users and published courses are always the current snapshot.
dashboard.onboardingDescription: Share this link with the current members of your community so they can sign up. They go through the Telegram gate and remain pending approval.

audit.title: Audit
audit.description: Immutable log of every critical action in the tenant. The hash chain makes any later modification detectable.
audit.chainValidDescription: We verified {count} consecutive entries. None was modified after its original recording.
audit.chainBrokenDescription: We detected a break at entry {id} ({fecha}). The entries before that point remain trustworthy.
audit.chainBrokenNote: This should NOT happen in normal operation — investigate who had direct access to the database.
audit.emptyDescription: There are no entries matching the filters. Try widening the range or removing filters.
audit.entriesDescription: Sorted by date, descending. Each row shows the actor, the action and the affected resource.
